lede: California carries the stronger underlying team rating — -1.4 against -1.7, a 0.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it California +1.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Clemson winning 55% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass offense, where California leads Clemson by 58 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
